purpose: Pre-Blender canonical skeleton target selection state. It records what may be selected now and blocks premature construction from unresolved evidence.
selection_rules: Grade C/D findings cannot receive a frozen exact target.
Grade A/B may receive a provisional target only if its measurement definition maps exactly to the intended canonical landmark.
A new Blender canonical-proportion candidate must not be generated while freeze_ready=false.
The first generated skeleton-first revision must have a new immutable identity distinct from mesh-fit a003.
